answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 48005 Country: INDIA Title: Sexual pleasure during sleep without seeing a sexual dream Question: I have learned that if a woman has a sexual dream and sees a discharge then ghusl is obligatory on her. But what if a woman does not see a sexual dream but she felt sexual pleasure during sleep and sees a discharge when she wakes up, will ghusl be obligatory on her even if she did not experience a sexual dream? Answer ID: 48005 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1511/1119/H=11/1434) If she felt physical pleasure and saw semen (discharge) after waking up then in such case ghusl is wajib: ولو تذكر الاحتلام ولم ير بللا لا يجب عليه الغسل والمرأة كذالك فى ظاهر الرواية لان خروج منيها الى فرجها الخارج شرط لوجوب الغسل عليها وعليه الفتوى اهـ فتاوى هنديه ج 1 ص 15 Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
